user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: European Plaza Fountain. A sunlit Mediterranean plaza: a tiered stone fountain with animated water at the center, surrounded by arcaded facades with shutters and balconies, café tables under striped umbrellas, a clock tower, a flower cart, potted orange trees, and patterned cobblestones. Water sparkles as it spills between the fountain basins. Style: mediterranean warm. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
